name: kofront frontend posts
author: kreativekabbage

sections.description:
kofront frontend posts is a lightweight, high-performance plugin that empowers users to create, edit, and manage blog posts directly from the frontend of your website without ever touching the standard WordPress backend admin dashboard.

Key Features:

  • Modular Post Builder: Easily add, reorder, and remove content blocks including headings, paragraphs, single images, and custom galleries.
  • Newspaper-Style Layouts: Choose between a clean Single Column layout or a dynamic, reading-optimized Two-Column newspaper flow with automatic text balancing and widow/orphan protection.
  • Native WordPress Media Integration: Securely utilize the built-in wp.media modal for image uploads, cover selection, and full gallery management.
  • Role-Based Access Control: Role-aware permissions for authors and editors to manage posts and control media library access safely.
  • Streamlined Security: Fully fortified with strict nonce verification, robust input sanitization, and strict capability checks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kofront folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Create a new page and add the [kofront_dashboard] shortcode to set up your frontend management hub.
  4. Add the [kofront_editor] shortcode to your posting page for the modular post creation interface.
sections.faq:
Do I need a specific theme to use kofront?

No, kofront is built to integrate cleanly with any standard WordPress theme using responsive, modern CSS standards.

Can authors upload their own images?

Yes! The plugin integrates natively with the WordPress media library, respecting user roles and permissions.
sections.changelog:
12.1.4

  • Added native Table of Contents (TOC) block with automatic jump-link generation and Rank Math SEO compatibility.
  • Added H1–H6 tag level selector and automatic anchor IDs for Heading blocks.
  • Added a dedicated Shortcode block to the frontend builder.
  • Improved backend Gutenberg editor compatibility by preserving custom backend blocks and applying the two-column wrapper dynamically.
  • Added a visual rich-text formatting toolbar (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, and links) for headings and paragraphs.
  • Enhanced security, input unslashing/sanitization, output escaping, and inline script handling.

12.1.3

  • Enhanced newspaper column text flow with strict orphan/widow controls.
  • Streamlined heading and gallery span-width automation for two-column views.
  • Comprehensive security hardening and Plugin Check (PCP) compliance updates.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of kofront frontend dashboard and modular builder.
